skill_name: Explain the features and benefits of a templating language.
workflow: A templating language is a type of programming language designed to separate program logic from presentational elements. Templating languages allow developers to separate their code into distinct layers of presentation and data processing, making it easier to maintain their code long-term. Templating languages can also provide greater flexibility, as developers can use conditional logic to generate different output based on user input or other variables.
